row.title: Sweeper gh helper returns status, never throws
row.body: Executor PR 1851 made the sweeper gh helper throw on any non-2xx answer. Every caller reads ok and status and records failures in out.errors, so the throw only aborted the sweep on expected answers (410 when issues are off, 405 on a merge GitHub declines) and broke seed/worker sweeper.test.js on main. The status return is restored; tests/test_sweeper.js is now a node test run in checks.
